summary: Nora's short links now come from her own self-hosted drop service instead of the n.example.net Worker.
details: Short URLs Nora sends now look like https://nora.example.net/i/<slug> rather than https://n.example.net/<slug>.
The mint bearer token moved from NORA_SHORTENER_TOKEN to NORA_DROP_TOKEN; deployments must set the new variable.
